name: harness-package-builder
description: The harness package builder: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI (@anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.319), run headless, seeded with the harness-package-builder skill, the shell template and the packages guide. Say "Create a harness package for <name>" and it researches the CLI (its docs, repository and registry page, with full outbound access), installs the latest stable version in its sandbox, tries it against this session's provider when the CLI speaks that API shape, observes the hosts it reaches, and writes the package under /workspace/<name>/ (harness.json, install, run, README.md, recorded fixtures and tests), validated with the platform's own check. Say what you need an agent for and it asks what changes what it will build, sends a plan, and builds a tailored, least-privilege package. The console turns the folder into a draft (New harness from workspace, on this session's page); Install, then a turn on the new harness is its real test. The one built-in harness, and not vanilla by design: its seeds are the platform's own builder skill.
